Roadmap and working plan

Last reviewed: November 17, 2026. GitHub issues track execution; this document records scope, order and release gates. Milestones are targets, not date promises.

Direction

Make SurveyCTO question and choice labels usable in R and RStudio from locally downloaded Excel forms and CSV exports. Development and automated tests must work without paid API access, a developer license or server credentials. Optional API wrappers remain available for eligible users; live verification is separate work.

Today: November 17, 2026

First resolve #10: the credential-dependent pkgdown build so documentation checks can run without server access.

  1. Review the existing local maintenance work under #2. Check the offline import and labelling workflow, preserve unrelated local edits, exclude credential/session files, and prepare the maintenance changes for review. Verify that repeated label text merging into a single factor level is documented.
  2. Implement #3: form validation. Start with required columns and one shared select/list parser. Reject malformed codes and report unsupported layouts explicitly. Add offline regression cases.
  3. Run R CMD check including the vignette, obtain passing hosted CI, and validate a de-identified Excel form plus matching CSV export from a community account. If representative exports are unavailable, finish the synthetic checks and keep the real-export acceptance item open. Do not claim a release gate has passed.

Today’s target is a reviewable offline maintenance release candidate. Larger features start after that baseline is reliable. If time is limited, complete steps 1 and 2; defer feature expansion and publishing a release.

Release gates

0.1.2: reliable offline baseline

Milestone

  • Local Excel forms and raw-code CSVs work without rsurveycto or credentials.
  • Single-select factors preserve code matching, choice order and question labels.
  • Reused choice lists and duplicate label text have regression coverage.
  • All three expanded multiselect modes work and preserve variable labels.
  • Missing/skipped versus unselected indicator behavior is documented explicitly.
  • Invalid and unsupported inputs produce useful errors or diagnostics.
  • Offline tests, installation and vignette build pass locally and in hosted CI.
  • A representative de-identified community export pair is verified.
  • Credential/session files are excluded from artifacts and public changes.

Current evidence from the local working tree: 23 passing assertions and full R CMD check with 0 errors, 0 warnings, one environment time-verification note. These are local results, not evidence of a merged release or live API compatibility. Schema validation and real-export verification are still pending.

0.2.0: broader local export support

Milestone

Add explicit raw multiselect expansion and language selection, with defined missing-value behavior, collision checks, offline fixtures and working examples. Preserve the established local workflow and identifiers.

Later

Design repeat handling and local external-choice resolution using representative export layouts. Nested repeats and dynamic server datasets require explicit scope before implementation. No commitment to automatic server synchronization or paid API infrastructure.

Keeping the plan current

  • Use issues for acceptance checklists, dependencies and implementation status.
  • Apply one priority label. A status label is optional for later backlog items. status: ready means scoped, not necessarily next; dependencies still apply.
  • Work on one implementation issue at a time. #1 is a regression tracked under #2.
  • Update this document when priorities, release scope or constraints change, and replace the dated Today section when choosing the next work session.
  • Close issues only after the fix and necessary tests are merged. Local work is in progress; blocked issues name their external prerequisite.
  • Release only after the milestone gates pass; keep unverified work open.
